ownScientificNotes: G1/S/G2 precede M, DNA is copied in S and already-copied information distributed during mitosis; cytokinesis yields daughter cells, active interphase is not rest.
The supplied relative DNA contents 2→4→2 per daughter are not chromosome counts; model lineage 1→2→4 after two complete cycles and duration 8+4+2+1=15 h are correct.
Plant-tip growth/wound repair/cutting and fresh animal-tissue/wound/unicellular examples cover all three claimed applications without equating one cell division with a whole multicellular offspring.

Suitable dividing eukaryotic cells and a simplified mitotic cycle are explicitly bounded; no bacterial mitosis, universal mature-cell division, mandatory advanced checkpoint claim or actual cell-culture evidence.

Mutation in a reproducing/transmitted lineage can create heritable variants; recombination reshuffles existing determinants and need not create new alleles. Origins of variation are distinguished from selection.

The beetle model correctly changes dark frequency 50%→80% among survivors and maintains80% in the controlled offspring step; differential survival changes next-generation contribution without recolouring individuals.
The fresh plant model has equal survival and unequal offspring contribution: F60%→180/220≈81.8%; selection can act through reproduction alone.

Environmental advantage is conditional, variation is not goal-directed; controlled contribution arithmetic in a sexual population is not literal single-parent asexual ancestry. Drift/speciation and broader source claims remain outside this exact goal.
